lines.en: label futabadorm40:
scene dorm
I knock on Futaba’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Futaba 的门，等她回应。

lines.en: : Come in!
lines.zh: : 进来！

lines.en: I worry for a moment that I may have accidentally selected Rin instead, but ultimately accept that she also lives in this room and that things like this will happen sometimes.
lines.zh: 我一度担心自己是不是不小心选成了 Rin 的房间，但最终还是接受了现实：她也住在这间屋里，这种事偶尔总会发生。

lines.en: scene black
I make my way into the room and go to take my shoes off, but am quickly stopped by a brigade of [teenager]s who appear to be on some sort of mission.
lines.zh: 我走进房间，正要脱鞋，却被一队似乎肩负着某种使命的[teenager]拦了下来。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym1
: Yo! You’re just in time for our mission.
lines.zh: : 哟！你来得正好，我们的行动正要开始。

lines.en: : Funny you should say that because-
lines.zh: : 你这么说还真是巧了，因为——

lines.en: : Because Sensei and I had other plans tonight.
lines.zh: : 因为 Sensei 和我今晚另有安排。

lines.en: : Thank you for showing up exactly when we agreed.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你准时赴约。

lines.en: : Now, I suppose I’ll be-
lines.zh: : 那么，我想我就先——

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym2
: No way, Nodoka! We’re all in this together!
lines.zh: : 不行，Nodoka！我们是一个团队的！

lines.en: : {i}But I am le tired...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可是我好累啊……{/i}

lines.en: : Uhh...I’m not interrupting something, am I?
lines.zh: : 呃……我没打扰到什么吧？

lines.en: : Not...particularly. But you did choose a bad time to show up.
lines.zh: : 倒、倒也不算。不过你来得确实不是时候。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym3
: We’re about to go get ripped! Wanna come with us, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我们正要去练出肌肉呢！Sensei 要一起来吗？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : What...Rin is trying to say is that...a new gym just opened up in the area and...I’m trying to be a little...healthier.
lines.zh: : Rin 想说的是……这附近新开了一家健身房……我想让自己……健康一点。

lines.en: : {i}We{/i} are trying to be a little healthier.
lines.zh: : 是{i}我们{/i}想让自己健康一点。

lines.en: : That's great, but isn’t it a little late to be going to the gym?
lines.zh: : 那很好啊，不过这个点去健身房是不是有点太晚了？

lines.en: : There are actually a lot of people who prefer going later because...it means there will be less people around to...watch you.
lines.zh: : 其实挺多人喜欢晚点去的，因为……这样周围看着你的人会少一些。

lines.en: : Like perverts?
lines.zh: : 比如变态？

lines.en: : If we were worried about perverts, we wouldn’t have invited you!
lines.zh: : 要是我们担心变态，就不会叫上你了！

lines.en: : Or Nodoka, for that matter!
lines.zh: : 换作 Nodoka 也是同理！

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym4
: Are you insinuating that I will be gazing longingly at your overworked, sweaty bodies, wishing to be the towel you use to dry yourselves off?
lines.zh: : 你是在暗示，我会盯着你们劳累出汗的身体看得入迷，恨不得变成你们用来擦汗的毛巾吗？

lines.en: : Nodoka, if there is anyone who understands that exact train of thought, it is me.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，要说最懂这种心思的人，那就是我了。

lines.en: : You are very much a beautiful disaster, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你真是一场美丽的灾难，Rin。

lines.en: : Thank you! But today isn’t about our unearthly cravings for the touch of a cute girl! It is about willpower! And determination!
lines.zh: : 谢谢！不过今天的主角不是我们对可爱女孩触碰的超凡渴望！而是意志力！还有决心！

lines.en: : Every day is about my unearthly craving for the touch of a cute girl.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，每一天都是关于对可爱女孩触碰的超凡渴望。

lines.en: : I’m with Nodoka on this.
lines.zh: : 这点我站 Nodoka。

lines.en: : Of course you are...
lines.zh: : 你当然站她……

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym5
: So...since that’s what we’re doing tonight...maybe you and Rin could...hang out some other time.
lines.zh: : 那个……既然今晚你们要做这件事……也许你和 Rin 可以……改天再聚。

lines.en: : Just to clarify, I came here to hang out with you, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 先说清楚，我是来找你玩的，Futaba。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym6
: What the hell?! But {i}I’m{/i} the one who answered the door! That means you're here for me!
lines.zh: : 什么鬼？！可是开门的{i}是我{/i}啊！那说明你是来找我的！

lines.en: : E-Even if you’re here to see me...it doesn’t change that the three of us already have plans, so...
lines.zh: : 即、即便你是来找我的……也不影响我们三个已经有约在先，所以……

lines.en: : Maybe some other time?
lines.zh: : 改天再说？

lines.en: : I see no harm in Sensei coming along to scope out the area. Perhaps he, too, is looking to tone up a bit?
lines.zh: : 我觉得让 Sensei 一起去踩个点也没什么坏处。也许他也想稍微练练身材？

lines.en: : I’m actually in surprisingly good shape for someone who never does anything.
lines.zh: : 对一个什么都不做的人来说，我的身材意外地不错。

lines.en: : Well, at least on the outside.
lines.zh: : 至少外表上如此。

lines.en: : I’ve tried running with Miku before and it made me want to die, so...yeah. Not really into the idea of exercising with you guys.
lines.zh: : 我以前试过和 Miku 一起跑步，那感觉让我生不如死，所以……嗯。我实在不太想跟你们一起运动。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym7
: I...suppose if it’s just to...see the area, it’s fine...
lines.zh: : 我……想如果只是……去看看地方，那倒是可以……

lines.en: : But...I already feel weird about doing this with Nodoka and Rin and...I’m sure you can see where I’m going with this.
lines.zh: : 但是……光是和 Nodoka、Rin 一起做这件事，我就已经觉得怪怪的了，而且……你肯定明白我接下来想说什么。

lines.en: : Yes, you are insecure about your body despite constant reminders from all of your friends and me that you’re gorgeous.
lines.zh: : 明白。尽管你所有的朋友和我都在反复告诉你你很美，你还是对自己的身材没有自信。

lines.en: : Sensei...validation and...compliments are nice and everything, but...they can’t really change the way a person sees themself.
lines.zh: : Sensei……认可和……赞美是很好啦，可是……它们改变不了一个人看待自己的方式。

lines.en: : So, yes...I am insecure and I’m...trying to actually go about handling that in a way that is...productive this time.
lines.zh: : 所以，是的……我确实没有自信，而且我……这次在试着用一种……有建设性的方式去处理它。

lines.en: : Had you been handling it...{i}un{/i}productively up until now?
lines.zh: : 在此之前你处理得很……{i}没有{/i}建设性？

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym8
: {i}The clock is ticking, the hours are going by. The past increases, the future recedes. Possibilities decreasing, regrets mounting.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}时钟滴答，时光流逝。过去在增加，未来在退去。可能性在减少，遗憾在堆积。{/i}

lines.en: : What happened “up until now” means absolutely nothing. And standing idly around and discussing it just prevents us from making the strides we need to reach our destination.
lines.zh: : “在此之前”发生过什么根本无关紧要。而站在这里无所事事地讨论它，只会妨碍我们迈出抵达目的地所需的步伐。

lines.en: : In summation, as Futaba’s makeshift attorney and the guardian of her heart, I implore you to wait until she is comfortable with discussing such matters and-
lines.zh: : 总之，作为 Futaba 的临时律师兼她心灵的守护者，我恳请你等她愿意谈论这些事的时候再——

lines.en: : It’s okay, Nodoka...I’ve been meaning to tell him soon anyway.
lines.zh: : 没关系，Nodoka……我本来就打算尽快告诉他的。

lines.en: : But “soon” is not today and I will not allow your already dwindling self-consciousness to become one more barrier between us and various exercise machines.
lines.zh: : 但“尽快”不是今天，而且我不会让你本就所剩无几的羞耻心，再变成横在我们和那些健身器材之间的又一道障碍。

lines.en: : Also, I want to see the exposed skin and tight, form-fitting spandex of women much older and stronger than me.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我还想看看那些比我年长、比我还强壮的女人的裸露肌肤和紧身氨纶运动服呢。

lines.en: : That does sound alluring so, I am once again siding with Nodoka on this.
lines.zh: : 听起来确实诱人，所以这一次我又站 Nodoka。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym9
: So...you’re definitely coming?...
lines.zh: : 那么……你真的要来？……

lines.en: : I won’t stay to watch you guys work out.
lines.zh: : 我不会留下来看你们锻炼。

lines.en: : I do have time to kill, though, and knowing where a place like this is would be a good thing in the event that my lungs begin to tire out or something.
lines.zh: : 不过我确实有空，而且万一哪天我的肺开始不行了之类的，知道这种地方在哪儿也是件好事。

lines.en: : Be sure to thank your organs every morning to prevent things like that from happening.
lines.zh: : 记得每天早上感谢你的器官，就能避免那种事发生。

lines.en: : That’s not how organs work, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 器官不是这么运作的，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Well...so long as you promise to not...stick around...
lines.zh: : 好吧……只要你保证不……赖着不走……

lines.en: : I guess it wouldn’t do any harm to just...walk there with you.
lines.zh: : 我想……就只是和你们一起走过去，应该也没什么坏处。

lines.en: : It’s not particularly far or anything. It’s only a few blocks away from the dorm, so...I’m sure a lot of other girls will wind up going there soon as well...
lines.zh: : 也不算特别远。离宿舍只有几个街区，所以……我猜很快也会有别的女生去那里……

lines.en: : Speaking of which, where's Otoha? I could have sworn she was part of your...brigade.
lines.zh: : 说到这个，Otoha 呢？我还以为她是你们那支……小队的一员。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym10
: She’s...busy writing tonight. So we’re just going to go without her.
lines.zh: : 她……今晚忙着写作。所以我们就不带她了。

lines.en: : She’d make us all feel weak and insignificant anyway since she actually works out and we are solanum tuberosum.
lines.zh: : 反正她也会让我们觉得自己又弱又渺小，毕竟她是真的有在锻炼，而我们只是 solanum tuberosum。

lines.en: : You are...what?
lines.zh: : 你们是……什么？

lines.en: : Potatoes.
lines.zh: : 马铃薯。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: scene black
Futaba ultimately accepts that she will not be able to prevent me from tagging along and, after sighing heavily to herself as she so commonly does, the four of us leave the dorm.
lines.zh: Futaba 最终接受了她没法阻止我跟着去这个事实，像往常一样重重地叹了口气后，我们四个人离开了宿舍。

lines.en: We begin walking in the direction of the maid cafe and I inadvertently become a bit more excited than I should be.
lines.zh: 我们朝女仆咖啡厅的方向走去，我不知不觉地比应该的程度更兴奋了一些。

lines.en: But I calm myself down when I realize that I will not be seeing girls in maid outfits and will instead be seeing them in spandex.
lines.zh: 但当我意识到自己要看到的不是穿女仆装的女孩、而是穿氨纶的女孩时，我冷静了下来。

lines.en: Actually, nope. Not calm at all. This is just as good.
lines.zh: 不对，完全冷静不下来。这个也一样棒。

lines.en: I thank the god I don’t believe in that I am wearing thick jeans and that any protrusion that may emerge from them is not my fault and that I can not be held accountable for having eyes.
lines.zh: 我感谢那个我并不信仰的神——我穿的是厚牛仔裤，从里面冒出来的任何凸起都不是我的错，而且长着眼睛这件事也不该由我来负责。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym11
Futaba tries to get me to leave once we arrive, but I remain insistent on seeing the inside as well because no one has changed clothes yet and that’s {i}kind of{/i} why I came in the first place.
lines.zh: 到了之后 Futaba 想赶我走，但我坚持要进去看看里面，毕竟大家都还没换衣服，而这正是我跟来的原因{i}之一{/i}。

lines.en: I’m sure that’s part of why she wants me to leave anyway, but I have seen her with immensely {i}less{/i} clothing before and don’t quite understand why it’s suddenly a big deal.
lines.zh: 我猜这也是她想让我走的原因之一，可我见过她穿得{i}少{/i}得多的样子，实在不明白为什么突然就成了一件大事。

lines.en: Once the girls get dressed and all of us step into the gym, however, we discover that we are not the only ones here.
lines.zh: 然而，等女孩们换好衣服、我们一起走进健身房时，却发现这里并不只有我们。

lines.en: : I like the gym now.
lines.zh: : 我现在喜欢上健身房了。

lines.en: : Is it...normal for your first reaction to a girl to be “Please hit me?”
lines.zh: : 你对一个女生的第一反应是“请打我吧”，这……正常吗？

lines.en: : Exceedingly normal. There is no other reaction I would accept right now.
lines.zh: : 再正常不过了。我现在不接受任何其他反应。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym12
I’m a bit surprised to find Yuki, of all people, kickboxing a punching bag in the same gym that my students are now going to be visiting.
lines.zh: 我有点惊讶，竟然会在这家我学生即将光顾的健身房里遇见 Yuki——偏偏是她——正对着沙袋练踢拳。

lines.en: But, I suppose she needs {i}some{/i} outlet for all of her built up anger now that she’s not...killing people for a living or whatever it is biker gangs do to stay afloat.
lines.zh: 不过，我想她总得{i}找个出口{/i}发泄积攒的怒火，毕竟她现在不靠……杀人之类的谋生了，管它飞车党是靠什么维持生计的。

lines.en: Also, under these circumstances, I too would enjoy being hit.
lines.zh: 而且，在这种情况下，我也挺想被打的。

lines.en: This might be the first time in my life I have ever wanted to switch places with a punching bag.
lines.zh: 这大概是我这辈子第一次想和一个沙袋交换位置。

lines.en: So, yeah. I guess this is a thing now.
lines.zh: 所以，行吧。看来现在就是这么个情况了。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym13
: Still feeling up to this, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 还撑得住吗，Futaba？

lines.en: : Well...it’s not like I have much of a choice since...all of us already came here.
lines.zh: : 嗯……反正我们都已经来了，我也没什么选择的余地。

lines.en: : I’d feel bad if we didn’t at least do {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: : 要是{i}一样{/i}都不做，我会过意不去的。

lines.en: : I...can’t help but feel a little intimidated by that woman, though...
lines.zh: : 不过……我忍不住有点被那个女人震住……

lines.en: : She doesn’t look so tough to me.
lines.zh: : 我看她也没多厉害啊。

lines.en: : Are you kidding? Look at her legs. Those things could kill someone.
lines.zh: : 你在开玩笑吗？看看她的腿。那双腿能踢死人。

lines.en: And I’m sure they have.
lines.zh: 而且我相信它们确实踢死过。

lines.en: : This might be the first time in my life I have ever wanted to switch places with a punching bag.
lines.zh: : 这大概是我这辈子第一次想和一个沙袋交换位置。

lines.en: : I really think we might be related, Nodoka. It’s actually starting to become a real concern of mine.
lines.zh: : 我真的觉得我们可能是亲戚，Nodoka。这已经快成为我真心担忧的事了。

lines.en: : So...umm...now that we’re here...
lines.zh: : 那么……嗯……既然我们都来了……

lines.en: : Are you going to get rid of me?
lines.zh: : 你打算把我赶走吗？

lines.en: : I’m just...seeing if you’re going to be true to your word or not.
lines.zh: : 我只是……想看看你会不会说话算话。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’ll head out in a second. I’m just going to give that woman a piece of my mind first for intimidating all of you impressionable, [young_girls].
lines.zh: : 嗯，我马上就走。不过我得先去跟那个女人说两句，让她别再吓唬你们这些容易受影响的[young_girls]。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym14
: W-Wait! You don’t have to go that far, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 等、等等！Sensei，你不用做到这个地步！

lines.en: : Yeah...No disrespect to you, but I’m pretty sure that girl could take you.
lines.zh: : 是啊……没有不敬的意思，但我敢说那个女孩能把你打趴下。

lines.en: : She can take {i}me{/i} any day of the week.
lines.zh: : 她哪天都能把{i}我{/i}打趴下。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it, Futaba. I know exactly how to deal with girls like her.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Futaba。我最清楚该怎么对付她那种女孩。

lines.en: : Sensei!
lines.zh: : Sensei！

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym15
I make my way over to Yuki, breaking her concentration on the punching bag and allowing it to live at least one more minute before being blown into pieces.
lines.zh: 我朝 Yuki 走过去，打断了她对沙袋的专注，让那沙袋至少能多活一分钟，不至于被轰成碎片。

lines.en: : Oh shit. What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 哦，该死。你怎么在这儿？

lines.en: : You didn’t really strike me as the type to work out.
lines.zh: : 你看起来真不像是会锻炼的人。

lines.en: : Yuki, can you help me look cool in front of my students and pretend that I intimidated you out of the gym?
lines.zh: : Yuki，你能不能帮我在学生面前撑个场面，假装是被我吓出健身房的？

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym16
: You fuckin’ serious right now?
lines.zh: : 你他妈是认真的吗？

lines.en: : Yuki, please. They need to know how cool I am.
lines.zh: : Yuki，拜托了。她们得知道我有多酷。

lines.en: : Fuck no, man. I’m still on my free trial. I’ve gotta make use of this time.
lines.zh: : 想都别想，老兄。我还在免费试用期呢。这段时间我得好好利用。

lines.en: : Unless you’re tryin’ to pay for my subscription or some shit.
lines.zh: : 除非你打算替我付会员费什么的。

lines.en: : I can’t. I’m already paying for your daughter’s phone bill.
lines.zh: : 不行。我已经在替你女儿付电话费了。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym17
: Oh. Well then no fuckin’ wonder she’s okay with screwing someone your age.
lines.zh: : 哦。那她愿意跟你这把年纪的人上床，也就不奇怪了。

lines.en: : For the last time, I-
lines.zh: : 我最后一次重申，我——

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym18
: Hi there. Nodoka Nagasawa. I may look fragile, but I am willing to take any punishment you’d like to throw at me.
lines.zh: : 你好。Nodoka Nagasawa。我看起来或许很脆弱，但我甘愿承受你想施加的任何惩罚。

lines.en: : Are you at all interested in younger women?
lines.zh: : 你对年轻女性有兴趣吗？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym19
: Excuse me, but...I can’t figure out how to turn on the water in the shower room...
lines.zh: : 打扰一下……我弄不明白淋浴间的水要怎么开……

lines.en: : You just...
lines.zh: : 你就……

lines.en: : You turn the knob...
lines.zh: : 把旋钮转一下……

lines.en: : Can...
: Can you show me?...
lines.zh: : 能带我去看看吗？……

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym20
: And stay out, bitch.
lines.zh: : 还有，滚出去，贱人。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym21
: Hah...
: You’re gonna owe me dinner for this shit.
lines.zh: : 这事儿你得请我吃顿饭。

lines.en: scene black
scene futabafirstgym22
: She’s gone. Your problems are solved.
lines.zh: : 她走了。你的问题解决了。

lines.en: : Uhh...Not all of them...
lines.zh: : 呃……没有全解决……

lines.en: : You’re still here...
lines.zh: : 你还在这儿……

lines.en: : Am I not allowed to support you the same way your other friends do?
lines.zh: : 难道我不该像你其他朋友那样支持你吗？

lines.en: : Sensei...you can...support me in your own way...
lines.zh: : Sensei……你可以……用你自己的方式支持我……

lines.en: : But...it’s pretty obvious that the reason you’re sticking around isn’t because of that.
lines.zh: : 但是……很明显，你留下来并不是因为那个原因。

lines.en: : Why is that obvious? I can do nice things from time to time.
lines.zh: : 为什么很明显？我偶尔也是会做点好事的。

lines.en: : Because...
lines.zh: : 因为……

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym23
: Because...uhh...
: What? What are you looking-
lines.zh: : 什么？你在看什——

lines.en: : Oh.
I guess my pants weren’t thick enough after all.
lines.zh: 看来我的裤子终究还是不够厚。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym24
: Hey!
: Hi, Rin. Don’t look down.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Rin。别往下看。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym25
: Of course I’m going to look down if you tell me not-
lines.zh: : 你叫我别看，我当然会往下——

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym26
: Oh.
: Well...yeah. Okay then.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧。行吧。

lines.en: : I tried to warn you.
lines.zh: : 我提醒过你了。

lines.en: : Yeah...Yeah, you did.
lines.zh: : 是啊……是啊，你提醒过。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I’m gonna go...punch things or...something...
lines.zh: : 我要去……打点东西之类的……

lines.en: : Okay, have fun.
lines.zh: : 好，玩得开心。

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhhhh okay.
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃好。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym27
: So...you see now why I feel weird about you staying here?
lines.zh: : 所以……你现在明白我为什么觉得你待在这里很别扭了吧？

lines.en: : It makes a little more sense now, yes.
lines.zh: : 现在确实更说得通了，嗯。

lines.en: : But I still don’t think you should be embarrassed about working out in front of me.
lines.zh: : 但我还是觉得，你不该因为在我面前锻炼就感到难为情。

lines.en: : I think it’s great that you’re trying to be healthier and-
lines.zh: : 我觉得你想变得更健康是件好事，而且——

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym28
: Can you please...{i}not{/i} do this right now?...
lines.zh: : 你能不能……现在先{i}别{/i}说这些？……

lines.en: : You can come see me tomorrow and...we’ll spend time together then...
lines.zh: : 你明天可以来找我……到时候我们再一起待着……

lines.en: : But if I’m going to be serious about doing this...I kind of need you to...not be around for it...
lines.zh: : 但如果我是要认真做这件事……我有点需要你……别在场……

lines.en: : It’s obviously nothing personal...I just...
lines.zh: : 显然不是针对你……我只是……

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym29
: I’m really...uncomfortable in my own skin, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我真的很……无法接纳自己的这副皮囊，Sensei……

lines.en: : And...no amount of encouragement or validation is going to change that...
lines.zh: : 而且……再多的鼓励和认可也改变不了这一点……

lines.en: : So...please...
lines.zh: : 所以……拜托了……

lines.en: : At least...not until I’m feeling a little better about this...
lines.zh: : 至少……等我稍微好受一点再说……

lines.en: I sigh to myself and accept that I’ve probably overstepped my boundaries tonight.
lines.zh: 我叹了口气，认了——今晚我大概确实越界了。

lines.en: I overstep my boundaries all the time, though.
lines.zh: 不过我本来就经常越界。

lines.en: I guess I just didn’t expect to be pushed back so firmly by Futaba of all people.
lines.zh: 只是没想到，偏偏会被 Futaba 这么坚决地推回来。

lines.en: Now that the tears have started to show up, though, I’m obviously not going to stick around any longer.
lines.zh: 但既然她已经开始掉眼泪，我显然不该再待下去了。

lines.en: Blowing things out of proportion wasn’t really at the top of my to-do list today, and it’s already starting to get late.
lines.zh: 把事情闹大本来就不在我今天的待办清单首位，而且天色也已经不早了。

lines.en: So...I should probably stop prodding her for now and wait until another opportunity arrives to see if we can progress any further.
lines.zh: 所以……我现在大概该停止试探，等下一个机会来了，再看看能不能更进一步。

lines.en: : Okay, I’m leaving.
lines.zh: : 好，我走了。

lines.en: : I’m happy for you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我为你高兴。

lines.en: : Well, as happy as I can be. Happiness isn’t really my thing.
lines.zh: : 嗯，在我能高兴的范围内吧。高兴本来就不太适合我。

lines.en: : And working out isn’t mine, but...we have to start somewhere.
lines.zh: : 锻炼也不适合我，不过……总得有个开始。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for almost crying.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我差点哭了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for making you almost cry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，害你差点哭了。

lines.en: : Well, as sorry as I can be. Apologeticness isn’t really my thing either.
lines.zh: : 嗯，在我能道歉的范围内吧。道歉本来也不太适合我。

lines.en: scene futabafirstgym30
: Okay...that’s enough. I’m not talking to you anymore.
lines.zh: : 好了……够了。我不跟你说话了。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’ll just go talk to Nodoka or-
lines.zh: : 没问题。那我去找 Nodoka 或者——

lines.en: : Wait, where did Nodoka go?
lines.zh: : 等等，Nodoka 去哪儿了？

lines.en: : Oh, she ran after that badass biker chick once she left.
lines.zh: : 哦，那个很酷的女机车佬一走，她就追出去了。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Yeah, that checks out.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这很合理。

lines.en: scene black
I leave the gym and begin my journey home.
lines.zh: 我离开健身房，踏上回家的路。

lines.en: I’m not sure how often I’ll go back to a place like that, especially considering that a certain someone really does not want me around, but I’m glad to know it exists, I guess.
lines.zh: 我不确定以后会多常去那种地方，尤其考虑到某个人是真的不想我在场，不过知道它存在，我大概还是挺高兴的。

lines.en: It’s good that Futaba is trying to change the parts of herself that she doesn’t like.
lines.zh: Futaba 愿意去改变自己身上不喜欢的那些部分，这是好事。

lines.en: If you don’t do that while you’re young, they’ll likely wind up becoming hideous aspects of yourself that are impossible to ignore or fix.
lines.zh: 如果年轻时不这么做，它们很可能会变成你身上丑陋的一面，无法忽视，也无法修补。

lines.en: And, no matter how hard you try to shut them out, something will always happen to remind you of them.
lines.zh: 而且，无论你多努力地把它们关在门外，总会有什么事发生，让你想起它们。

lines.en: To transport you back to better days, when it was still possible to-
lines.zh: 把你带回到那些更好的日子里，回到一切都还来得及——

lines.en: I decide to call Ami and talk to her for the rest of my walk home.
lines.zh: 我决定给 Ami 打电话，剩下的回家路上就和她聊聊天。
